en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, from Muhammad Bin Sinan, from Quteyba Al A’ash who said,
‘The Momina (female Believer) is more cherished than the Momin, and the Momin is more cherished than the alchemy. So who from you has (ever) seen alchemy?’.
en.sarwar: 1. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn ‘Isa from Muhammad ibn Sinan from Qutaybah al-‘A’sha’ who has said the following:
‘The female believer is more valued than a male believer and a male believer is more valued than alchemy. Who among you has ever seen alchemy?’”
